newsitem.title: MOLDOVA: Moldovan consumer prices fall 0.3 pct in August.
newsitem.headline: Moldovan consumer prices fall 0.3 pct in August.

text.p: Moldovan consumer prices fell by 0.3 percent in August after rising 0.1 percent in July, a State Statistics Department official said on Monday.
MOLDOVAN CONSUMER PRICES Aug '96 July '96 Aug '95
The official said the fall in consumer prices, due to seasonally low food prices in the mostly agricultural country.

Prices in the first eight months of the year rose 9.2 percent. The authorities and the National Bank have said they expected annual inflation to slow this year to 17 percent from 23.8 percent in 1995.
